rights_evidence.finding: Both official catalogue records identify the datasets as public government works. The formulary files additionally require compliance with the CMS Agreement for Use, including accurate and non-misleading use and explicit temporal limitations.

bronze_boundaries: Preserve formulary, pharmacy-network, beneficiary-cost, pricing, indication-coverage and insulin-cost tables separately at source-native plan and NDC grain.
Preserve annual spending claims, beneficiaries, dosage units, gross spending, manufacturer and outlier fields without treating them as net prices or total U.S. utilisation.
Keep annual final-action spending separate from preliminary quarterly spending and preserve suppression/redaction semantics.
Do not interpret CMS Part D records as total U.S. medicine utilisation or as coverage for excluded employer and PACE plans.
